timeline.draft_answer: The evidence describes one sustainable fertilizer production approach: producing compost from human excreta (sewage sludge) and urban green waste. In rural South Africa, ETH postdoc Benjamin Wilde is working with the Msunduzi municipality and the local public utility Duzi Turf to convert sewage sludge from pit latrines together with urban green waste into compost, which is then used as fertilizer. The chunks do not specifically discuss low-carbon or zero-emission industrial fertilizer manufacturing (e.g., ammonia/nitrogen fertilizer) beyond this composting/waste-recycling approach.
